newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint firms vs dlr, balanced BCE futures trade.
newsitem.headline: Forint firms vs dlr, balanced BCE futures trade.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed firmer against the dollar on the interbank forex market but it remained weaker than the central bank bid, dealers said on Friday.
"The forint moved in a narrow range in somewhat hectic trading," said Zsolt Kovari of ING Bank.
The forint closed at 153.85/90 to the U.S. unit compared with an opening of 154.10/15.
Kovari added that the forint remained some 15 to 20 pips below the central bank bid which at midday stood at 153.75.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE), dollar, Ecu and mark futures traded most actively, accounting for the bulk of the total 4.22 billion forints turnover.
Most currency futures finished lower, except for the sterling which remained unchanged, and the dollar, which firmed.
